hooks.prompt:
Evaluate if Claude should commit code changes before stopping.

This project uses jj (Jujutsu VCS), not git.

Rules:
- BLOCK if significant code changes were made (new features, bug fixes, refactors)
- APPROVE if only research, reading, or trivial changes (typos, comments, configs)

Respond with EXACTLY this JSON format, nothing else before or after:
{"ok": true, "decision": "approve", "reason": "explanation"}

Or to block:
{"ok": true, "decision": "block", "reason": "explanation"}
